segments.text: You monster, your sin is unforgivable.

content.full_text: Go. Why? You monster, your sin is unforgivable. Heaven's punishment ends here. Turns out, I remember. This is a distant memory. Don't be afraid. I'll wait for you. Actually. This aura. It is heaven's will. I finally see you.
